answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, unlocked only after continuous uptime, each submission carries a fresh nonce. The violet of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. A vine of per-task receipts records who did what, and the grove of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
